properties.originalSourceDataset: Curated visitor envelope derived from the OpenStreetMap settlement point, with adjoining public green spaces
properties.methodology: Morphological closing of the preserved official built-up-area geometry using a 150 metre outward and inward buffer. This fills internal omissions for connected parks, river corridors and visitor green spaces without applying a general outward town buffer.

townStudyArea.notes: The official locality geometry is preserved unchanged. The active visitor boundary uses a transparent 150 metre morphological closing to include connected parks, river corridors and green spaces omitted by the statistical built-up-area geometry. This is a visitor extent, not an administrative replacement.
